title: Achievements in salinity control
creator_credit: Victoria. Dept. of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
brief_description: Looks at the problem of salinity and its effects on irrigated agriculture. Explains the formation of the water table and the resultant salinity due to poor drainage and evaporation. Focuses on a number of strategies and research developments to combat the problem.
